chapter: Reel 2-3: tunes, closing and country life
title: Buddy Barley and who went up in the balloon
summary: Toyama asks whether Barley was the one who went up and whether anyone else did, followed by a dog question.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: Oh, by the way, this Buddy Bartley, did he all... You see the one who always went up there or... No, I think he's a girl. Or any other people went up there too? I mean, except for the lady. The woman? Yeah. Any white guy went up there? No. I've been on the street with him. I mean, they could. But it finally... We had a brother back there. How about a dog? How about a dog? How about a dog? A dog? A dog?
A dog, yeah. Didn't dog go up in the air? No. I didn't have a cellar bag.
